shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone surface
justification: Both are shallow relief carvings on flat framed stone surfaces containing figural imagery, but A shows a single naturalistic bearded human figure in profile holding a tall spear with detailed pleated drapery, while B shows stacked registers of schematic animals (a row of crouching quadrupeds, birds, a snake-like form and a long-necked bird) with no human figure. The only correspondence — relief figures in profile within a framed field — is the kind any relief tradition could produce independently, and the rendering conventions (fine incised naturalistic detail vs blocky abstracted animal bodies) differ sharply.
